comment: Shared Wan cross-surface capability expectations (#806). Rust tests in mold-core, mold-ai (CLI), mold-ai-discord, and mold-ai-tui, plus the TS test studio/lib/wanSurfaceParity.test.ts, all read this file so a drift in any surface's Wan presentation or request semantics fails CI. Additive: new capability domains (e.g. #783 sequence rows) join as new top-level keys without touching existing ones.

frame_grid.comment: Valid frame counts are 4k+1. Surfaces that accept a raw frame count snap onto this grid and disclose the substitution; they never submit an off-grid value.

container_default.comment: Server policy (GenerateRequest::normalise_output_format): an unset output format on these families defaults to MP4; a single-frame wan render is a still (#798) and stays PNG. The CLI mirrors this in mp4-enabled release builds and truthfully degrades to APNG for families whose MP4 encoder is behind the `mp4` feature in minimal builds.

first_last_frame.comment: TI2V pins both endpoints in latent space (4x temporal stride); below nine pixel frames nothing remains to denoise. CLI, Discord, studio, and server admission all enforce this floor before dispatch.

recipe.comment: Distill strengths are (0, 4], offered only on the Lightning tiers; the solver row cycles wan's flow solvers (wire: the existing scheduler slot), never the SD UNet schedulers.

text_only_refusal.template: '{model}' is text-to-video and cannot continue motion across a clip boundary, so rendering {total_frames} frames would repeat the same ~{clip_frames}-frame clip rather than extend it. Reduce the frame count to {clip_frames} or fewer for one continuous clip, or use an image-to-video tier (wan22-i2v-a14b, wan22-ti2v-5b:turbo), which seeds each continuation with the previous clip's final frame.
text_only_refusal.comment: A ONE-SHOT (ephemeral) auto-chain past the tier's routing clip size is refused at every door for a wan tier whose source_image contract is `unsupported`: it has nothing to hand across a clip boundary, so every stage re-derives the scene from the same prompt and seed and the long video is the same clip repeated with a visible reset. `mold_core::chain::text_only_wan_auto_chain_refusal` is the single authority; the CLI router, the server's POST /api/chain-jobs admission, and studio/lib/chainRouting.ts all call or mirror it and render `template` byte-identically. `clip_frames` is `mold_core::chain::routing_clip_frames` - the family floor raised by the tier's own `tier_default_frames`. AUTHORED sequences (ephemeral false) are untouched: repeated stages there are what the author asked for.
